## Network reachability and speed

Can the rest of the world reach it, and how good is the path?

| Resource | Run by | What it is and when to use it | Kind | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Globalping](https://globalping.io/) | jsDelivr | Web form for running ping, traceroute, DNS, MTR, or HTTP from probes in places you pick; integrations include CLI and API; free within hourly limits. | Online service | Freemium |
| [M-Lab Speed Test](https://speed.measurementlab.net/) | Measurement Lab | Measurement Lab's speed test, which measures download, upload, latency, and retransmission with NDT; you agree first that results, IP address included, are published. | Online service | Free |
| [Cloudflare Speed Test](https://speed.cloudflare.com/) | Cloudflare | Cloudflare's connection test: download, upload, latency, jitter, and packet loss, with scores for streaming, gaming, and video calls. | Online service | Free |
| [Hurricane Electric Looking Glass](https://lg.he.net/) | Hurricane Electric | Hurricane Electric's looking glass: choose a router and run a BGP route lookup, BGP summary, ping, or traceroute against an address or hostname. | Online service | Free |
| [CIDR.xyz](https://cidr.xyz/) | Magic Monad LLC | Interactive CIDR calculator showing a range's netmask, base and broadcast addresses, usable range, and count as you edit the bits; with an FAQ. | Online service | Free |
| [ipcalc (IP Calculator)](https://jodies.de/ipcalc) | Krischan Jodies | IP calculator: give an address and one or two netmasks, in CIDR or dotted form, for results including network, broadcast, and host range, bits shown. | Online service | Free |
| [NTP Pool Project](https://www.ntppool.org/en/) | NTP Pool Project (Develooper LLC) | pool.ntp.org, a cluster of time servers open to everyone, with sections including how to use the pool, how to join it, and information for vendors. | Online service | Free |
| [Ncat](https://nmap.org/ncat/) | Nmap Project | Netcat reimplementation shipped with Nmap, with features including port redirection, SSL, and SOCKS4 or HTTP proxying; links its Users' Guide and man page. | Tool | Free |
| [iperf3](https://github.com/esnet/iperf) | ESnet (Energy Sciences Network) | Measures the maximum bandwidth achievable on an IP network over TCP, UDP, or SCTP; maintained by ESnet. | Tool | Free |
| [mtr](https://github.com/traviscross/mtr) | Travis Cross (traviscross) | Network diagnostic tool that does the work of traceroute and ping in one program. | Tool | Free |
| [Test your IPv6](https://test-ipv6.com/) | APNIC Labs | Tests whether your browser and connection can reach sites over IPv6, and displays the IPv4 and IPv6 addresses you are using. | Online service | Free |

Listed here from another domain: iperf3 ([Networking and connectivity](networking-and-connectivity.md#lookup-and-diagnostic-tools)), mtr ([Networking and connectivity](networking-and-connectivity.md#lookup-and-diagnostic-tools)), Test your IPv6 ([Networking and connectivity](networking-and-connectivity.md#lookup-and-diagnostic-tools)).

## DNS, IP, and registration lookups

What does DNS answer, and who holds this name or address?

| Resource | Run by | What it is and when to use it | Kind | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [MxToolbox SuperTool](https://mxtoolbox.com/SuperTool.aspx) | MxToolbox | MxToolbox's lookup box for a domain, host name, or IP address, with command prefixes such as mx:, spf:, dmarc:, and blacklist: listed in a table. | Online service | Free |
| [DNS Checker](https://dnschecker.org/) | Softrix Technologies | Checks how a DNS record resolves on name servers in many countries, by record type, to follow a change as it propagates. | Online service | Free |
| [NsLookup.io DNS lookup](https://www.nslookup.io/) | NsLookup.io | DNS lookup site: enter a domain for its main record types, then pick public, authoritative, or local DNS servers on the results page. | Online service | Free |
| [RDAP.org lookup](https://client.rdap.org/) | Gavin Brown | RDAP lookup form with query types including domain, TLD, IP or CIDR, AS number, and entity; queries go from your browser straight to the registry. | Online service | Free |
| [Dig web interface](https://www.digwebinterface.com/) | Martin Holk Rasmussen | Web front end to dig: query record types for one or more hostnames against name servers you pick, with options such as showing the command. | Online service | Free |
| [1.1.1.1 DNS resolver help](https://one.one.one.one/help/) | Cloudflare | Cloudflare's diagnostic page for its 1.1.1.1 resolver, with checks including whether you use it over HTTPS, TLS, or WARP and which data center answers. | Online service | Free |
| [Google Admin Toolbox](https://toolbox.googleapps.com/apps/main/) | Google | Google's web tools for troubleshooting Workspace: Check MX and Dig for DNS, Messageheader for mail delivery, HAR and log analyzers, and browser debugging pages. | Online service | Free |
| [whatsmydns.net DNS Propagation Checker](https://www.whatsmydns.net/) | whatsmydns.net | Looks up a DNS record on name servers in many countries at once and maps the answers, to show how far a change has propagated. | Online service | Free |
| [ICANN Lookup](https://lookup.icann.org/en) | ICANN | ICANN's tool for current registration data: type in a domain name, IP network, or AS number, and it fetches the record over RDAP. | Online service | Free |
| [DNSViz](https://dnsviz.net/) | Casey Deccio | Enter a domain name to get a diagram of its DNSSEC authentication chain, with the configuration errors the tool found. | Online service | Free |

Listed here from another domain: Google Admin Toolbox ([Email, DNS, and collaboration](email-dns-and-collaboration.md#lookup-and-test-tools)), whatsmydns.net DNS Propagation Checker ([Email, DNS, and collaboration](email-dns-and-collaboration.md#lookup-and-test-tools)), ICANN Lookup ([Networking and connectivity](networking-and-connectivity.md#registries-and-numbering)), DNSViz ([Networking and connectivity](networking-and-connectivity.md#lookup-and-diagnostic-tools)).

## Web and TLS testers

Is this server's TLS, SSH, or header setup right?

| Resource | Run by | What it is and when to use it | Kind | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Qualys SSL Labs SSL Server Test](https://www.ssllabs.com/ssltest/) | Qualys | Qualys test of a public server's SSL/TLS setup, by hostname; an option keeps the result off its boards of recent, best, and worst hosts. | Online service | Free |
| [testssl.sh](https://testssl.sh/) | Dr. Wetter IT-Consulting | Command-line TLS tester for any service, STARTTLS included, not just web servers; runs with nothing to install on systems including Linux and macOS; GPLv2. | Tool | Free |
| [badssl.com](https://badssl.com/) | The Chromium Project | Test hosts with broken or unusual TLS setups, grouped by kind, including expired and self-signed certificates, RC4 and 3DES cipher suites, and mixed content. | Online service | Free |
| [HSTS Preload List Submission](https://hstspreload.org/) | The Chromium Project | Explains HSTS and the preload list built into Chrome, with sections including submission requirements, deployment recommendations, and the form to check and submit a domain. | Online service | Free |
| [Security Headers](https://securityheaders.com/) | Snyk | Scans a site's HTTP response headers and grades them from A+ to F, with boards of recent scans and of the best and worst results. | Online service | Free |
| [HTTP Observatory](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/observatory) | Mozilla | Mozilla's free scanner on MDN: enter a site to have its HTTP headers and related security settings graded; the FAQ covers its limits. | Online service | Free |
| [CSP Evaluator](https://csp-evaluator.withgoogle.com/) | Google | Google's checker for how well a Content Security Policy blocks cross-site scripting, by CSP version, with sample policies; also a Chrome extension. | Online service | Free |
| [How's My SSL?](https://www.howsmyssl.com/) | How's My SSL? | Shows how the TLS client you are browsing with rates, including its protocol version, key support, session tickets, compression, and insecure cipher suites. | Online service | Free |
| [KeyCDN Tools](https://tools.keycdn.com/) | proinity LLC | KeyCDN's free web and network tools, including a website speed test, HTTP header checker, HTTP/2 and Brotli tests, DNS checker, ping, and traceroute. | Online service | Free |
| [SSH Configuration Auditor](https://www.ssh-audit.com/) | Positron Security | Web form for auditing an SSH server by hostname or address, as a scored standard audit or a pass-or-fail policy audit; also audits clients. | Online service | Free |
| [openssl-s_client manual page](https://docs.openssl.org/master/man1/openssl-s_client/) | OpenSSL | OpenSSL's manual page for s_client, its command-line SSL/TLS client, with sections including synopsis, options, basic and advanced connected commands, notes, and bugs. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [OpenSSL Cookbook](https://www.feistyduck.com/library/openssl-cookbook/) | Feisty Duck Limited | Ivan Ristić's book on the OpenSSL command line and on testing TLS with it; free to read online, with PDF and EPUB behind a sign-in. | Reference | Free |
| [Let's Debug](https://letsdebug.net/) | Let's Debug | Form that takes a domain name and a validation method (HTTP-01, DNS-01, or TLS-ALPN-01) and tests for problems that stop Let's Encrypt issuing a certificate. | Online service | Free |

## Decoders, encoders, and converters

What does this token, timestamp, or blob say?

| Resource | Run by | What it is and when to use it | Kind | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Base64 Decode and Encode](https://www.base64decode.org/) | HAZOTA Europe Kft | Base64 decoder with a text box, file upload, a character set menu, and an explainer with sections including padding, line breaks, and the URL-safe variant. | Online service | Free |
| [Epoch Converter](https://www.epochconverter.com/) | Misja.com | Unix timestamp tools including conversion to dates and back, in seconds through nanoseconds, start and end epochs for a period, and code examples by language. | Online service | Free |
| [JSONLint](https://jsonlint.com/) | Todd Garland | JSON validator and formatter in an editor box, above sections including what JSON is, proper format, and common errors; a separate Mac app is paid. | Online service | Freemium |
| [Diffchecker](https://www.diffchecker.com/) | Checker Software Inc. | Compares two texts and marks the differences, with modes including images, documents, spreadsheets, and folders; basic web tool is free, Pro and desktop are paid. | Online service | Freemium |
| [OAuth 2.0 Debugger](https://oauthdebugger.com/) | Nate Barbettini | Builds an OAuth 2.0 authorization request from fields including the URIs, client ID, scope, and response type, sends it, and shows what comes back. | Online service | Free |
| [curlconverter: curl commands to code](https://curlconverter.com/) | Nick Carneiro | Converts a curl command into code for Python, JavaScript, Go, and other languages, and shows how to copy a request as curl from a browser. | Online service | Free |
| [DevToys](https://devtoys.app/) | Etienne Baudoux and Benjamin Titeux | Open source desktop toolbox for Windows, macOS, and Linux whose offline tools include JWT decoding, hash generation, and text comparison; also runs from a terminal. | Tool | Free |
| [regex101](https://regex101.com/) | Firas Dib (firasdib) | Online regular expression tester: write a pattern, run it against text, and inspect matches and capture groups; a paid Pro plan adds further tools. | Online service | Freemium |
| [crontab guru](https://crontab.guru/) | Cronitor | Type a cron schedule expression and read it back in words, with its next run time; by Cronitor, which advertises its monitoring service there. | Online service | Free |
| [jwt.io](https://www.jwt.io/) | Okta | Debugger for decoding, verifying, and generating JSON Web Tokens. | Online service | Free |
| [OneLogin SAML online tools](https://developers.onelogin.com/docs/saml/online-tools/) | OneLogin | Browser tools for SAML work: decode and validate requests and responses, build metadata, format certificates, and generate a self-signed certificate. | Online service | Free |
| [CyberChef](https://gchq.github.io/CyberChef/) | GCHQ | GCHQ's browser tool for transforming data: drag operations such as Base64 decoding or decryption into a recipe and apply it to your input. | Online service | Free |

## Packet capture and HTTP debugging

What is actually going over the wire?

| Resource | Run by | What it is and when to use it | Kind | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Wireshark Display Filter Reference](https://www.wireshark.org/docs/dfref/) | Wireshark Foundation | Index of the protocols Wireshark can filter on, each linking to its list of display filter fields. | Reference | Free |
| [Wireshark Wiki: SampleCaptures](https://wiki.wireshark.org/SampleCaptures) | Wireshark Foundation | Wireshark wiki page of capture files to download, grouped by protocol, with notes on adding a capture and pointers to capture collections elsewhere. | Dataset or feed | Free |
| [Wireshark User's Guide](https://www.wireshark.org/docs/wsug_html_chunked/) | Wireshark Foundation | Contents page of the Wireshark manual, with chapters including building and installing, the user interface, capturing live network data, and working with captured packets. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [mitmproxy](https://www.mitmproxy.org/) | Mitmproxy Project | Open source proxy for intercepting, modifying, and replaying web traffic, including HTTP/2, HTTP/3, and WebSockets, driven from a command line, web interface, or Python API. | Tool | Free |
| [Fiddler](https://www.telerik.com/fiddler) | Progress Software Corporation | Web debugging proxies for HTTP and HTTPS from Progress Telerik: Fiddler Everywhere by subscription, and Fiddler Classic, limited by its EULA to eligible non-commercial use. | Tool | Freemium |
| [httpbin.org](https://httpbin.org/) | httpbin.org | Public test server for HTTP clients: endpoints such as /post, /headers, and /anything echo what you sent; the page states its rate limits. | Online service | Free |
| [Webhook.site](https://webhook.site/) | Webhook ApS | Captures HTTP requests, emails, and DNS lookups sent to addresses it generates; free URLs last a week and hold 50 requests, paid accounts more. | Online service | Freemium |
| [HTTPie](https://httpie.io/) | HTTPie, Inc. | API testing client: an open source tool for the terminal, and apps for web and desktop in public beta. | Tool | Free |
| [Chrome DevTools: Inspect network activity](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/devtools/network) | Google | Google's tutorial on the DevTools Network panel, including logging requests, showing more information, simulating a slower connection, and capturing screenshots. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [Firefox Network Monitor](https://firefox-source-docs.mozilla.org/devtools-user/network_monitor/) | Mozilla | Firefox documentation for the Network Monitor: opening it, a tour of its interface, and pages including the request list, request details, and throttling. | Vendor documentation | Free |
| [lnav (The Logfile Navigator)](https://lnav.org/) | Tim Stack (tstack) | Terminal log viewer that needs no server: point it at a directory of logs; has an SQLite interface and a demo reachable over SSH. | Tool | Free |
| [GoAccess](https://goaccess.io/) | Gerardo O. (allinurl) | Web log analyzer written in C that reads formats including Apache, Nginx, and CloudFront and reports in a terminal or a web dashboard; MIT licensed. | Tool | Free |
| [Wireshark](https://www.wireshark.org/) | Wireshark Foundation | Captures packets and decodes them protocol by protocol for close inspection; installers for Windows and macOS, with source for other systems. | Tool | Free |
| [tcpdump and libpcap](https://www.tcpdump.org/) | The Tcpdump Group | Project site for the tcpdump packet analyzer, a command-line tool, and for libpcap, a library for capturing network traffic, with releases, man pages, and documentation. | Tool | Free |

## Rescue and system diagnostics

How do I boot, test, or inspect a machine that is misbehaving?

| Resource | Run by | What it is and when to use it | Kind | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [SystemRescue](https://www.system-rescue.org/) | SystemRescue | Bootable Linux rescue system for repairing Linux and Windows computers, with tools including GParted and fsarchiver; guides, manual chapters, and a tool list are linked. | Tool | Free |
| [GParted](https://gparted.org/) | GParted | Graphical partition editor with actions including create, resize, move, and copy, on file systems including btrfs, ext4, and NTFS; GParted Live is its bootable edition. | Tool | Free |
| [TestDisk](https://www.cgsecurity.org/wiki/TestDisk) | Christophe Grenier (CGSecurity) | GPL data recovery program whose abilities include fixing partition tables, rebuilding FAT and NTFS boot sectors, and undeleting files; lists supported operating systems and filesystems. | Tool | Free |
| [Memtest86+](https://www.memtest.org/) | Samuel Demeulemeester | Home of the GPL memory tester Memtest86+: downloads, nightly builds, and sections including why to test RAM, installing on removable media, and troubleshooting RAM errors. | Tool | Free |
| [GNU ddrescue](https://www.gnu.org/software/ddrescue/) | GNU Project (Free Software Foundation) | GNU tool for copying a disk or file with read errors; given a mapfile it reads only the blocks needed and resumes an interrupted rescue. | Tool | Free |
| [htop](https://htop.dev/) | htop | Interactive text-mode process viewer built on ncurses for systems including Linux, FreeBSD, and macOS; site links include downloads, screenshots, and an FAQ. | Tool | Free |
| [strace](https://strace.io/) | strace | Linux utility that traces the system calls and signals of a process, including attaching to a running one and filtering by call or path; LGPL. | Tool | Free |
| [ncdu](https://dev.yorhel.nl/ncdu) | Yorhel | Home of ncdu, which shows what fills a disk from a terminal on POSIX-like systems: notable updates, downloads, packages and ports, and similar projects. | Tool | Free |
| [sysstat](https://sysstat.github.io/) | Sébastien Godard | Home of sysstat, the Linux package of performance tools including sar, iostat, mpstat, and pidstat: release news, with features, download, and FAQ pages linked. | Tool | Free |
| [Ventoy](https://www.ventoy.net/) | longpanda | Prepares a USB drive once, after which you copy disk images onto it and choose one from a boot menu; open source. | Tool | Free |

Listed here from another domain: Ventoy ([Endpoint and device management](endpoint-and-device-management.md#packaging-imaging-and-software-deployment)).

## Quick references and practice

Where is the short answer, and where can I practice?

| Resource | Run by | What it is and when to use it | Kind | Cost |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [MDN: HTTP response status codes](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Reference/Status) | Mozilla | MDN's list of HTTP response status codes in informational, successful, redirection, client error, and server error groups, with short explanations and links to per-code pages. | Reference | Free |
| [The Art of Command Line](https://github.com/jlevy/the-art-of-command-line) | Joshua Levy (jlevy) | One-page guide to command-line fluency, in sections including one-liners, system debugging, everyday use, and processing files and data, with translations. | Reference | Free |
| [SadServers](https://sadservers.com/) | SadServers Inc. | Linux and DevOps troubleshooting challenges on live servers, for practice and for assessing hires; some open without signing up, and paid plans add more. | Training or lab | Freemium |
| [Mess with DNS](https://messwithdns.net/) | Julia Evans and Marie Claire LeBlanc Flanagan | A sandbox that gives you a subdomain to add DNS records to and shows each request that arrives for it, for learning by experiment. | Training or lab | Free |
| [explainshell](https://explainshell.com/) | Idan Kamara (idank) | Type a command line and see each argument explained from its help text, with a choice of which distribution's manpages to use. | Online service | Free |
| [Linux man pages online](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/) | Michael Kerrisk | HTML versions of the Linux man-pages project's manual pages, plus a selection from other free software projects, listed by section, alphabetically, or by project. | Reference | Free |
